mapper.sql: select o.order_id,o.activity_id,o.hotel_id,o.room_id,o.guest_name,o.phone,o.check_in_date,o.check_out_date, o.room_count,o.amount,o.order_status,o.del_flag,o.create_by,o.create_time,o.update_by,o.update_time,o.remark, h.hotel_name,r.room_name from yc_hotel_order o left join yc_hotel h on h.hotel_id=o.hotel_id and h.del_flag='0' left join yc_hotel_room r on r.room_id=o.room_id and r.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, ifnull(sum(case when order_status='1' then 1 else 0 end),0) as confirmedCount, ifnull(sum(case when order_status='2' then 1 else 0 end),0) as cancelledCount from yc_hotel_order where activity_id=#{activityId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: update yc_hotel_order set del_flag='2' where order_id in #{id}
